question: What is the fate of the wicked who revile Kula over vast time?
premises: The wicked are deluded regarding Kula.
Even immense time does not remove this obstruction.
inference: For them there is no progress even in hundreds of crores of ages.
uncertainties: gatir may mean spiritual progress or final liberation.
plain_english: And for them there is no progress, even in hundreds of crores of ages.
